zh: A 的元素个数要最少，而在个数固定为 k 时，和最大的选法显然是取最大的 k 个数；sum(A)>sum(B) 等价于 A 的和大于总和减去 A 的和。
把数组降序排列，依次取最大的剩余元素。第一次出现“已取之和严格大于剩余之和”时停止：此前的任何 k 都连最大的 k 个数都不够，所以这个 k 最小，同时这个前缀也让该 k 下的和最大。
降序排序并求总和（可达 10^10，用 64 位）；逐个累加前缀和 taken，一旦 taken>total−taken 就停止，记录个数 k；把这 k 个数反转成升序；先输出 k，再每行输出一个数，重复值照常保留。
en: A must have as few elements as possible, and for a fixed size k the largest possible sum clearly comes from the k largest numbers; sum(A) > sum(B) means the sum of A exceeds the total minus the sum of A.

Sort in descending order and keep taking the largest remaining element. Stop the first time the taken sum is strictly greater than the remaining sum: for any smaller k even the k largest numbers were not enough, so this k is minimal, and this prefix also has the largest sum for that k.

Sort descending and compute the total (up to 10^10, so use 64 bits); add elements to the running sum taken one by one and stop as soon as taken > total - taken, recording the count k; reverse those k numbers into ascending order; print k, then one number per line, keeping duplicates.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the elements in descending order and take the largest remaining element one at a time; stop the first time the taken sum is strictly greater than the remaining sum, and output the taken prefix reversed.

## Proof of correctness

For a fixed number k of taken elements, the k largest elements have the largest possible sum. If this prefix still does not qualify, no k-element choice qualifies; therefore the first k that qualifies is the minimum. That prefix also gives the largest total for this k, so both levels of optimization are satisfied. Reversing the descending prefix gives the ascending output.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n); the sum can reach 10^10, so 64-bit or arbitrary-precision integers are required.
